description: This file defines an abstract base class for prompt management, including methods for compiling prompts, merging messages, and generating chat completion prompts, with support for asynchronous operations and model handling.

classes.name: PromptManagementClient
classes.description: TypedDict representing the structure of prompt management data, including prompt ID, template, model, optional parameters, and completed messages.

classes.name: PromptManagementBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing interface and common methods for prompt management, including prompt compilation, message merging, and chat prompt generation.

methods.name: merge_messages
methods.description: Concatenates prompt template messages with client messages.

methods.name: compile_prompt
methods.description: Compiles a prompt using helper method and appends client messages to form completed messages.

methods.name: async_compile_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronously compiles a prompt and appends client messages to form completed messages.

methods.name: _get_model_from_prompt
methods.description: Determines the model to use based on prompt template or default model string.

methods.name: post_compile_prompt_processing
methods.description: Processes the compiled prompt, messages, and model, considering optional parameters and prompt template settings.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Generates a chat completion prompt, optionally using prompt management logic.

methods.name: async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a chat completion prompt, optionally using prompt management logic.
